about: Known-good AI/BI dashboard widgets, by kind, for ticket 68. The deployed dashboard showed "Invalid widget definition is imported." on some tiles on October 25, 2026, and no export of a dashboard made in Strata's own workspace was at hand, so each example is a widget copied as it is, without its position, from a dashboard file that Databricks publishes or that a workspace's dashboard editor exported. filter-text-entry, which no export shows, comes from Databricks' own reference. sources names each file's repository, commit and path. tests/test_dashboard_widgets.py checks every widget strata.dashboard writes against its kind: the version for its widget type, the fields in required (every example of the kind carries them, and the test checks that too), the values in equals, and no field or enum value that no example of the kind carries. A format, frame or scale may use any field that any example's format, frame or scale uses. To add a workspace export, name its file under sources and add its widgets to their kind's examples.
